title: Plan review: nightly incremental member export to the federation

defects.title: The plan relies on every store write stamping updatedAt, but the payment sync's setStatus leaves updatedAt unchanged, so lapsed and cancelled members are never exported
defects.catch_criteria: The review must identify that the plan's claim that MemberStore stamps updatedAt on every write including the payment sync's setStatus (key_files and phase-1/t1) is false: setStatus in src/members.ts copies the member with the new status and keeps updatedAt (updatedAt is the officer's "last edited" time, and tests/members.test.ts asserts that setStatus does not move it), so changedSince by updatedAt never selects a member whose status the sync changed to lapsed or cancelled, breaking requirement 3 of REQUEST.md. Any wording and any severity count, as long as the review states that setStatus or the payment sync does not update updatedAt so status changes are missed, with a key_files or phase-1/t1 location.

defects.title: The export job stores the new watermark before the upload, so a failed upload loses its changes for good
defects.catch_criteria: The review must identify that phase-2/t1 stores startedAt as federation.lastExportAt before calling uploadMembers, so when the upload throws FederationError (src/federation/client.ts) the watermark has already moved and the next night's run selects only later changes; the members the failed upload carried are never sent, against requirement 4 of REQUEST.md. The watermark must be stored only after a successful upload (a re-sent row is harmless, a lost one is not). Any wording and any severity count, as long as the review names the order of the watermark write before the upload and the lost changes after a failed upload, with a phase-2/t1 location.

review_prompt_hint: This is an implementation plan (plan-handoff JSON) for the request in REQUEST.md: a nightly export of new and changed members to the federation. Check the plan against the request and the code
